::: {#hero-heading}
This is a foundational digital archive and information infrastructure offered by the Kenya Agricultural and Livestock Research Organization (KALRO). It brings together soil data and information from across projects and sources, and provides access to nationally-consistent, standardized and readily useable soil data and information to support evidence-based decisions on sustainable land management in Kenya. The soil data are systematically generated, collated, curated, standardized, catalogued and maintained by the Kenya Soil Survey (KSS) section within KALRO, which is recognized by the government of Kenya as providing the national reference centre for soils. Some of the datasets are freely downloadable, while others may be accessed upon submission of requests. 
:::

&nbsp;

---

## Explore Resources 

## Data

Access data and maps of Kenyan soils, landscape and climate. The maps depict the predicted distribution of soil properties and soil health indicators, such as soil erosion risk, soil nutrient depletion, soil organic carbon decline, soil acidity, etc. [Read more](data.md)

::: {#data}
:::

## Publications

Looking for current and historical soil survey reports, as well as guidelines, standard operating procedures and protocols for soil data collection, analysis, curation, management, modelling, mapping, application and service? Access them here [Read more](./reports/index.qmd)

::: {#reports}
:::

## Linked Web Resources 

Access soil data, information and maps from other useful web resources from around the world, such as ISRIC's SoilGrids, Africa Union's Soil Observatory, ISDA Soil, etc. [Read more](./web-resources.md)

::: {#resources}
:::

## Our Commitment

We are committed to:

- Providing **open, standardized, high-quality** soil information  
- Supporting **evidence-based decision-making**  
- Advancing **soil science research** in Kenya  
- Enabling sustainable management of land and soil resources
